thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager -> @Dee (oncall). Alert: canary eu-inference-canary showing sustained 5xx rate 18% (>15%) and p95 latency spikes. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/inf-canary-eu

Dee (oncall): ack, looking into it now. I'll grab the canary control plane and check traffic weight.

Dee (oncall): quick peek: 502/503 dominant, p95 ~1.2s, canary weight = 10%. running: `rctl get canary eu-inference-canary` ->
```
name: eu-inference-canary
weight: 10
status: degraded
errors_5xx: 18%
active_sessions: 14
```

Ben (infra): I see autoscaler churn in the last 6m — scale-up/scale-down thrash. New nodes warmed kv-cache, then eviction churn leading to OOM retries. I'm going to pause the autoscaler and set min=2 to stabilize.

Ben (infra): `autoscalerctl pause eu-runtime && autoscalerctl set-min eu-runtime 2` :gear:

Alice (sre): propose kill-switch flip for canary traffic: set feature flag `canary-eu-enabled` -> false and drain the canary pool. That avoids a full rollback while we validate.

Alice (sre): `ffctl set canary-eu-enabled false --env prod` :thumbsup:

Dee (oncall): flipping flag now. `ffctl set canary-eu-enabled false --env prod` -> response: `ok`
Dee (oncall): canary weight -> 0, starting drain. active_sessions: 12 -> projected <3 in 30s.

InfraBot: deploybot: rollback triggered by @Ben -> initiating rollback of eu-runtime to v2026.02.18, job-id=deploy-4482. Logs: `pull image v2026.02.18 -> bootstrap -> healthchecks`

Chandra (pm): quick customer impact check: which tenants seeing failures? any billing-impacting customers?

Dee (oncall): initial sampling from logs: errors mainly from embed/generate endpoints for EU-hosted API. Top affected tenants: tenant-acme, tenant-lumos, a few anonymous small tenants. Rough estimate ~3% of total requests, concentrated. No major enterprise outage yet but degraded experience for those tenants.

Ben (infra): rollback finished on eu-runtime. running smoke checks. `curl -sf https://eu.api.redwood.example/health` -> OK

Dee (oncall): running sample generate: `curl -sS -XPOST https://eu.api.redwood.example/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> 200 and token stream starts, latency ~120ms.

Alice (sre): I'll run the canary verification suite (canary-gen) against control and rolled-back cluster for 5 minutes, compare error rates and latencies. Run id: canary-gen-172468.

Dee (oncall): handoff: I'm handing to @Alice for verification and postmortem follow-up. I'll stay available for any questions. :white_check_mark:

Alice (sre): ack, taking over. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and start drafting a short incident note (incident-2026-03-eu-canary-fast-rewind).

incident-bot: Incident status -> resolved (severity 2). Summary: autoscaler churn caused KV/cache pressure and transient OOMs -> elevated 5xx in canary. Mitigation: paused autoscaler, flipped canary flag (drain), rollback to previous stable runtime, verification passed. Duration ~18m.
